_note: Presentation colours (0-255) and the water's light the core draws with (crates/core/src/look.rs). players: the four lobby seats' colours, filling a model's "player" slot. ink: a tile's letter and value, plain and in a real word. water: lightly underwater and cartoony. light.fog is the murk at eye level and the fog's colour; zenith the murk overhead, down the murk looking down, each turning in over its band (hundredths of the view's height); sheen the light from the surface. shafts fan from the surface (counts stripes to the radian, drifting once round in drift_ms; strength and power in hundredths; fade: cosines from the light where they fade in and are whole). caustics: three ripples (wavelength, heading, period) whose meeting lines make the net on faces that look up, power their sharpness, strength_pct their brightness. gallery: the sand disc (floor colour, floor_pct of the camera's distance across), one turn of the turntable in turn_seconds, the field of view, margin_pct room round a model, the fog from and to fog_pct of the camera's distance, and the zoom: each step zoom_step_pct, between zoom_pct of the fitted distance.

held._note: A tile in a claw is drawn at tile_pct of its size (the crab is under half a tile across, SECOND-ORDER R1.8); it shrinks over change_ms when grabbed and grows back as it is let go. Placed and ghost tiles are full size. tilt_deg: a held tile's face tipped up from flat, back toward the camera behind the crab, so its letter reads (a grabbed tile is always held face up, flipping over as it shrinks). spread_mm: each held tile set out sideways from its claw so two sit side by side.

marks._note: The word marks (crates/core/src/marks.rs), mm: the glowing strip in the owner's colour round a word's whole run of squares, the dashed border of alternating colours round a tile in words of several owners, and the ring round a ghost tile's foot. board: strips flat on the board round the tiles' feet; tiles: strips on the tiles' tops, over their edges and the gaps between them, with a short skirt hanging from its outer edge (lip_mm). y_mm is the strip's height, inner_mm its inner edge from a square's middle (a tile is 200 wide, its value sits up to 87 from its middle), width_mm its width. radius_mm rounds the outer corners; step_mm lifts each mark above the one before and widens it so crossing strips never fight; dash_mm is about one dash. ghost: the ghost ring's colour (sea-glass aqua, BRIEF.md's Style).

play._note: The game's screen (crates/core/src/app/view3d.rs). fov_deg: the third-person camera's vertical field of view; near_mm and far_mm its planes; fog_mm: where the water's fog starts and ends; popup_ms: how long a "-2" popup shows. overhead: the board from above in the bottom-left corner: size_pct of the screen's height (big_pct while Tab is held), margin_pct of the screen's height from its corner, fov_deg its narrow field of view (nearly flat), room_pct round the board; each crab a see-through circle circle_mm across, alpha_pct solid, lifted lift_mm over the board, with sides edges.
